notes: DEAD ARM, AND THE EXPECTED RESULT IS ZERO. The whole StC_Mode == 2 open-loop arm -- this unit only call to interp1d -- is made unreachable by moving the tested value to a mode number no configuration can hold. coverage/line_coverage.json records Controllers.f90:1003-1012 at 0 hits in all 27 scenarios, so 0 of 5,252,000 is a CORROBORATION of that zero and not a failure of this red test.

AND THE REASON IS NOT THAT NO SCENARIO CONFIGURES IT. Examples/vit_sim.py scenario 24 sets StC_Mode = 2, StC_Group_N = 1, StC_GroupIndex 2801 and Ind_StructControl 8, with OL_Mode = 1 -- it is the one scenario in this campaign built for exactly this arm. It never reaches DISCON main block: coverage puts 0 hits on DISCON.F90:136 (the IF (StC_Mode > 0) guard) under scenario 24 while DISCON.F90:141 carries 8,000, so all 8,000 calls fall through to the ELSEIF. Units #23 and #26 measured the cause -- Read_OL_Input takes its RETURN on the absent Examples/example_inputs/OL_Mode2_Input.dat, and STATUS.md has carried scenario 24 executing no controller code as an E3.3 failure since phase 3. The differential harness is the instrument that reaches this arm; it kills every mutant on it.
